series.visual_description: Main panel: black filled circular markers, generally rising from low values at early steps to high values near steps 45–50.
series.axis_selection_reason: The circular markers are plotted against the single main panel's Step horizontal axis and Value vertical axis.

series.visual_description: Main panel: black filled square markers, generally declining from high values at early steps to lower values near the final steps.
series.axis_selection_reason: The square markers are plotted against the single main panel's Step horizontal axis and Value vertical axis.

series.visual_description: Main panel: black solid moving-average line, rising overall from approximately 20 at the early steps to approximately 81 at step 50; no distinct markers.
series.axis_selection_reason: The solid moving-average line uses the same single main-panel Step and Value axes as Series 1.

series.visual_description: Main panel: black dashed moving-average line, declining overall from the high 80s at early steps to the high 30s near step 50; no distinct markers.
series.axis_selection_reason: The dashed moving-average line uses the same single main-panel Step and Value axes as Series 2.
